from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///./shopflow.db"

engine = create_engine(
    SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}
)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
Base = declarative_base()

def get_db():
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

from typing import List
from backend.models.order import Order
from backend.models.enums import OrderStatus
from typing import Annotated
import logging
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from backend.database import get_db
from backend.models.order import Order, OrderStatus
from backend.schemas.order import OrderCreate, OrderResponse, OrderUpdateStatus
from datetime import datetime

orders_router = APIRouter()


@orders_router.post("/", response_model=OrderResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK)
def create_order(order_data: OrderCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """创建新订单"""
    db_order = Order(
        user_id=order_data.user_id,
        status=OrderStatus.PENDING.value,
        total_amount=order_data.total_amount,
        items=order_data.items if order_data.items else [],
        created_at=datetime.utcnow()
    )
    db.add(db_order)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(db_order)
    return db_order


@orders_router.get("/", response_model=List[OrderResponse], status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK)
def get_orders(db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """获取所有订单列表"""
    orders = db.query(Order).all()
    return orders


@orders_router.get("/{order_id}", response_model=OrderResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK)
def get_order(order_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """获取单个订单详情"""
    order = db.query(Order).filter(Order.id == order_id).first()
    if not order:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Order not found")
    return order


@orders_router.put("/{order_id}/status", response_model=OrderResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK)
def update_order_status(order_id: int, status_data: OrderUpdateStatus, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """更新订单状态"""
    order = db.query(Order).filter(Order.id == order_id).first()
    if not order:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Order not found")
    
    # 验证状态转换是否合法
    current_status = OrderStatus(order.status)
    allowed_next_states = current_status.next_states()
    
    if status_data.new_status not in allowed_next_states:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            detail=f"Invalid status transition from {order.status} to {status_data.new_status}"
        )
    
    order.status = status_data.new_status
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(order)
    return order


@orders_router.delete("/{order_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
def delete_order(order_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """删除订单"""
    order = db.query(Order).filter(Order.id == order_id).first()
    if not order:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Order not found")
    db.delete(order)
    db.commit()
    return None

from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import List
from datetime import datetime


class OrderCreate(BaseModel):
    """创建订单请求体"""
    user_id: str
    total_amount: float
    items: List = []


class OrderResponse(BaseModel):
    """订单响应体"""
    id: int
    user_id: str
    status: str
    total_amount: float
    items: List
    created_at: datetime

    class Config:
        from_attributes = True


class OrderUpdateStatus(BaseModel):
    """更新订单状态请求体"""
    new_status: str
